Error.description: The error envelope; the request id is also in `x-request-id`

AccountStatusName.description: A user's status on the wire.

AdvanceOnboarding.description:
`POST /v1/onboarding/advance`: the step the caller expects to leave. Other fields the console
sends are ignored.

from.description:
The step the caller expects to leave: `welcome`, `survey`, `profile`, `create_org`,
`create_project`, `api_key` or `finish`.

AuditEventBody.description: An audit event on the wire.

reason.description: The operator's note; `null` when none was given.

AuditPage.description: The newest audit events, newest first.

CatalogueModelBody.description: A model of the active catalogue, as a customer sees it.

locked_until.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` unless the target is locked.

CreateOrganisation.description: `POST /v1/orgs`: a name, optional slug and integrator-only external reference.

external_reference.description:
An integrator's own id for this organisation. Integrators only; a repeat returns the
existing organisation (200).

slug.description: The organisation's slug; derived from the name when absent.

IntegratorBody.description: An integrator's credential metadata on the wire; never the secret.

active.description: Whether the credential is neither revoked nor expired.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` when the credential does not expire.

last_used_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` until the credential is first used.

prefix.description: The first characters of the credential, for recognising it.

InviteMember.description: `POST /v1/orgs/{org}/members`: who to invite, and as what.

IssueIntegrator.description: `POST /v1/admin/integrators`: a name, and how long the credential lasts.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the credential expires, from 1 to 3650; absent for no expiry.
Days until the key expires; omit for a key that does not expire.

name.description: A name a person can read.

rate_limit_per_day.description: Requests allowed per day; omit for no limit.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Requests allowed per minute; omit for no limit.

IssuedIntegrator.description: A newly issued integrator: the only reply that carries the credential.

credential.description: The `gmi_` secret, shown once: it is not stored and no later call returns it.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` when the credential does not expire.

prefix.description: The first characters of the credential, for recognising it.

IssuedKey.description: A newly issued key. This is the only response that carries the secret.

api_key.description: The `gmr_` secret, shown once: store it now, it cannot be retrieved again.

key_prefix.description: The first characters of the key, for display.

message.description: A reminder that the secret is shown once.

KeyBody.description: A key as listed: never the secret, never the hash.

active.description: Whether the key is neither revoked nor expired.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` when the key does not expire.

key_prefix.description: The first characters of the key, for display.

last_used_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` until the key is first used.

name.description: The name the key was given, or `null`.

rate_limit_per_day.description: Requests allowed per day, or `null` for no limit.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Requests allowed per minute, or `null` for no limit.

LogPage.description: A page of the request log, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

cost_charged.description: Always null: the engine holds no price (D-17).

latency_ms.description: How long it took, in milliseconds.

model.description: The model that served it, or `null` when none did.

provider.description: The provider that served it, or `null` when none did.

tokens_in.description: Input tokens, or `null` when the provider did not report them.

tokens_out.description: Output tokens, or `null` when the provider did not report them.

display_name.description: The display name; `null` when the identity provider sent none.

platform_admin.description: Whether the user is a platform administrator.

MemberBody.description: A membership on the wire: a member who signed in, or an invitation.

display_name.description: The member's display name; `null` for an invitation.

email.description: The member's address, or the invited one.

user_id.description: The member's user id; for an invitation no user holds yet, the membership's id.

MembershipStatusName.description: Whether a member has signed in.

ModelAllowlist.description:
A project's allowlist: the request of `PUT …/models` (the whole list, replaced) and the
response of both `GET` and `PUT`.

models.description: Catalogue model ids. An empty list allows no model.

ModelPerformance.description: One model's share of the usage.

cost.description: Always null: the engine holds no price (D-17).

tokens.description: Tokens used; `null` when any count is unknown.

OnboardingBody.description: The caller's onboarding state on the wire.

completed_steps.description: The steps already left, in order.

OnboardingStepName.description: A step of the console's onboarding, in its order.

ParkedUsageBody.description: A parked usage export: metadata only, never the receiver's reply.

reason.description: A bounded failure classification; `null` when none was recorded.

status.description: The receiver's HTTP status; `null` when none was returned.

PlatformMembershipBody.description: A user's organisation and role, in a directory row.

PlatformOrgBody.description:
An organisation row on the wire. The billing columns are integer minor units, `0` until
billing exists.

last_activity.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` when the window holds no request.

tokens.description: Tokens in the window; `null` when some are unknown.

projects_incomplete.description: Whether more projects exist than the bound shows.

incomplete.description: Whether more organisations exist than the bound shows.

PlatformProjectBody.description:
A project row on the wire. The billing columns are integer minor units, `0` until billing
exists.

last_activity.description: RFC 3339, UTC; `null` when the window holds no request.

tokens.description: Tokens in the window; `null` when some are unknown.

incomplete.description: Whether more projects exist than the bound shows.

active.description: Whether the user may sign in (not suspended).

username.description: The display name, or the address when the user has none.

total.description: How many users match in all, beyond this page.

default_model.description: A catalogue model id, or `null` when the project has no default.

RenameOrganisation.description:
`PATCH /v1/orgs/{org}`: the new name, the only field M1 changes. Any other field (`plan`,
`status`, …) is refused, never silently ignored.

RequeuedBody.description: How many parked exports were queued again.

ResourceStatusName.description: A resource's status on the wire (an organisation or a project).

RoleBody.description: A role and the permissions the decision table gives it.

permissions.description: Permission names such as `organisation:read`, in a fixed order.

RoleName.description: A role's name on the wire.

superadmin.description: Always `true`: anyone else never reaches the route.

TimeRange.description: The window a usage report covers.

UpdateProject.description:
`PATCH /v1/orgs/{org}/projects/{project}`: exactly one of name, tenant status, or default
model. Null clears the default; omission leaves it unchanged.

Send exactly one of `name`, `status` (`active` or `suspended`) or `default_model`; `null`
clears the default.

default_model.description: A catalogue model id; `null` clears the default.

UsageReport.description: A project's usage over a window.

model_performance.description: Requests and tokens per model served.

UsageSummaryBody.description: The totals of a usage window.

average_latency_ms.description: The mean latency in milliseconds, rounded; 0 with no request.

p95_latency_ms.description: The 95th percentile latency in milliseconds; 0 with no request.

p99_latency_ms.description: The 99th percentile latency in milliseconds; 0 with no request.

percentile_sample_count.description: How many of the newest request latencies informed the percentiles.

percentiles_sampled.description: Whether the percentiles cover only the newest part of the window.

success_rate.description: Completed requests over all requests; 0 with no request.

total_cost.description: Always null: the engine holds no price (D-17).

total_requests.description: Requests that finished in the window.

total_tokens.description:
Tokens used; `null` when any request's input or output count is unknown, 0 for an empty
window.

IntegratorKey.description: A platform-issued integrator credential: provisioning operations only

get.summary: `GET /openapi.json`: the admin document, generated from this same router.
`GET /v1/admin/audit?limit=`: the newest audit events, newest first.
`GET /v1/admin/me`: `{superadmin: true}`; anyone else never gets here.
`GET /v1/admin/orgs?window=`: the oldest organisations, with an incomplete flag at the bound.
`GET /v1/admin/orgs/{id}?window=`: one organisation and its projects.
`GET /v1/admin/projects?window=`: the oldest projects, with an incomplete flag at the bound.
`GET /v1/admin/projects/{id}?window=`: one project.
`GET /v1/admin/usage-outbox/parked`: metadata for parked exports, oldest first.
`GET /v1/admin/users?limit=&start=&q=`: a page of users and the total that match.
`GET /v1/analytics/usage?project_id=&from=&to=`.
`GET /v1/auth/me`: the signed-in user, and whether they are a platform administrator.
`GET /v1/catalogue`: the active supplier catalogue and version.
`GET /v1/catalogue/{version}`: an immutable supplier catalogue version.
`GET /v1/logs?project_id=&page_size=&cursor=`.
`GET /v1/models`: the active catalogue, for any signed-in user.
`GET /v1/models/{model}`: one model of the active catalogue.

post.summary: `POST /v1/onboarding/complete`: completes onboarding; completing again changes nothing.

get.summary: `GET /v1/onboarding/state`.
`GET /v1/orgs`: human memberships or the integrator's own organisations.

post.summary: `POST /v1/orgs`: a new organisation (201), or integrator reference replay (200).

delete.summary: `DELETE /v1/orgs/{org}`: deletes it with everything in it (owners; 204).

get.summary: `GET /v1/orgs/{org}`.
`GET /v1/orgs/{org}/members`: members and invitations, oldest first.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /v1/orgs/{org}/members/{member}`: the member removed, or the invitation withdrawn
(204).

get.summary: `GET /v1/orgs/{org}/projects`: the organisation's projects, oldest first.

post.summary: `POST /v1/orgs/{org}/projects`: a new active project (owners and admins; 201).

delete.summary: `DELETE /v1/orgs/{org}/projects/{project}`: deletes it with its keys (owners and admins; 204).

get.summary: `GET /v1/orgs/{org}/projects/{project}`.
`GET …/keys`: the project's keys, oldest first, revoked ones included.

post.summary: `POST …/keys`: a new key (201). The secret is in this response only.

delete.summary: `DELETE …/keys/{key}`: revokes the key (204). Revoking a key already revoked is a 204.

get.summary: `GET …/models`: the models the project's keys may use.
List only provider, hint, timestamps and policy.

delete.summary: Remove a credential, returning to pooled service or required-policy refusal.

put.summary: Replace a credential; plaintext exists only in this request and in encryption memory.

get.summary: `GET /v1/roles`: the three roles, each with the permissions the decision table gives it.
